answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 50317 Country: India Title: Qasr Salah Question: I often have to travel out of my city for business trip, I usually go to trip ranging from 7 to 15 or more days, please clarify in details after how many days qasr namaz will have to offer? Answer ID: 50317 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 310/257/B=01/1435) The ruling of journey shall be applicable on you when you leave your place or its surroundings on a journey of 77.25 kms or more than it and stay there less than fifteen days and it shall be wajib for you to offer salah with qasr. But if you intend to stay for fifteen days or more in the same place or the place is on a distance less than 77.25 kms then you will have to offer full salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
